name: Pompadour
source:
Lord Pompadour is the animal confidante of Cyrus Vescovi. He is first seen in Chapter 2. [spoiler]Pompadour becomes an adoptable animal in Chapter 16.[/spoiler]

Cyrus often holds Pompadour in his arms and talks to him, imagining responses from his pet. Cyrus also has no qualms about using his Sapphire Comb on his beloved pet. [spoiler]The reason Cyrus offers for you to adopt him is because Cyrus wants to make sure he has the best life, and that despite all his owner's crimes, he has been a good dog.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Pompadour]Wiki[/url]]
